title: Retrospective mortality risk stratification in critically ill patients with documented hypoferremia: analysis code and aggregate outputs
description: Version 1.3.1 publishes the R3 reporting corrections to the retrospective ICU risk-stratification study. Documentation and AUROC intervals are synchronized to unchanged canonical functions: DeLong internally and class-stratified percentile bootstrap with 2000 resamples and seed 42 for temporal/exploratory cohorts. Primary models were not retrained and their predictions, AUROC point estimates and Brier scores are unchanged. The pre-existing NIV-exclusion sensitivity was refitted only for verification; all four rows reproduce its canonical aggregate reference. The version-specific DOI is assigned by Zenodo at deposition. Patient-level data, identifiers, outcomes, individual probabilities, cohort-ID lists, and fitted preprocessing or model objects are not redistributed.
